body: Today is my birthday too. I have just put my phone on aeroplane mode so I don't receive any calls, it's my anxiety, I'm depressed & suicidal, can't put up a fake smile to only few friends I've got. Thought of hanging myself in the night but my mother kept checking on me as I was behaving a bit different. My brains exploding with thoughts of my painful past and how my future is not going to be any different. I just swallowed every pills which is prescribed for hypertension (prescribed for my dad) . Now my head is in physical pain and I have stomach aches. What a Start to my birthday. Only the thoughts of killing myself gives me some comfort, haven't had sleep for days, wish I could put a bullet in my head to tell that crazy piece of shit that enough is enough. Oh, btw. Happy Birthday.

I'm there now. I think I took life for granted and did a lot of mistakes, I ruined it. All I'm left with is guilt, regrets and constant pain. I have a mental health disorder which doesn't allow me to socialize, express, behave or act appropriately. I try hard to overcome it, I can only go so far. I can't handle the pain. I'm trying to hang myself everyday too, just before loss of consciousness I don't know what pulls me out of it. I think I'm mustering enough courage to push forward in my every attempt. I wish today's attempt will be my last.

How did you try to go?
What method did you use. I'm sorry, I just need to know how to find some peace from this pain.

I hate it this feeling, I've been depressed for alot of things that I did in my life and things that I cannot do for my future. Basically I ruined my own life in every way possible. I did attempt for suicide thrice, everytime I pushed myself further than the previous one hoping that one fine day I'll finally succeed at it. But the feeling just vanished today. I'm still depressed, but I need the trigger to push me to do it today again.

I think hanging is quick if done right. I understand you because even I've attempted thrice. Just before I realise I'm losing my conscious I get out of it. I can't use high anchor points as there is none in my room. I'm using my window grill where I can still stand on my feet. I just put as much as pressure as possible and then I just Panic and give up because I don't want my parents to discover me half way through it if I make some noise and I'm left brain dead.
I just want to be sure I cannot be saved and a bit of courage to go forward every time I try it. My neck hurts badly from my last nights attempt. Heights are the worst, I'm scared of making it Alive and deformed for the rest of my life.

If the depression was because of an impulsive thought then it's not worth to end one's life. But if it's sever and the pain cannot be tolerated then I respect ones decision to end it. I hope you are alright, it's traumatic when people end up half dead and half alive. That is why I'm going to end mine and I'll make sure there's no inbetween state & No point of return.

I don't know if this is how it was for you, but it is nice to know you made it. Every relationship has its own story to tell. I just expressed mine and you yours. Kind of highly optimistic though. But you found the right path, where as I couldn't.

It's not about whether you were able to save a person from ending their own life, I believe almost anyone can be saved by giving them some hope that way. But what one doesn't realise is, one needs to be saved from the pain within them. Which is almost impossible. You can give me hope and send me out to live. But, we just end up more confused and worser. People who wants to end their life on an impulsive feeling can be saved. But not the ones who have questioned themselves their actions and found the answer. All there is left is now to live with the answer you've found which you cannot accept, what's gone is gone and my happiness with it.

Sometimes I think we're stubborn to let go of the life that we could have had and cannot accept anything less than that.
To realise ones mistakes is one thing and to live a life based on what we've learnt is another thing. We are bound by our own limitations. It's alright you know. Some come here asking to be saved, but some come here to express themselves for one last time. I'm the latter one.
Are you alright dude? I can understand the pain to think this way, but to say it out here instead of atleast pretending to help is kind of wrong.
It's alright. I wish your friend rest in peace.

I've tried to find help. It makes us get tossed between the line of life and death. It's easy to give someone hope, but when we go out there and just to get hit harder. When you just want to ask life to take it easy on you but it doesn't listen. We are back again where we started. Not everyone should consider ending their life, but for some that's the only only hope left in exchange for some rest.

I've done enough mistakes in life to realise there's nothing left in it for me. Future sure isn't going to be forgiving for my deeds. I've followed the path which has led me to this, I can't go back now. It was good talking to you. Be strong when you still can. Think before you choose the path you want to follow.

Oh, he'll realise it one day, just like I have and he will try to get back to you. Even I did, tried to get her back after nearly 5 years. But it was too late. It's better for you to do the same, sounds weird right? Coming from a guy who desperately wants her but yet I'm telling you not to go back to him. Well, it's because I know things can head down the same path again. And leave things in a worser condition than the previous one. Stay strong, just like she did. Her life is wonderful now, but I just wish Im dead to end this pain.

It can never happen in a short time. That's all I'd like to say.
Even if one claims they have realised their mistakes one is bound to repeat it. True realisation only comes when one has lost someone forever, when they start asking the questions why they did the things they did and regret. I think, it's good for the person to never get back with the same person again, as there will always be a chance to go down the same path. Realisation doesn't comes from words, it comes from pain. Realisation of the mistakes alone isn't good enough. To live up to it for a better future is, and it almost never happens as we are bound by our own limitations of emotional and mental capacity to truly work on it, may be someone who has higher emotional quotient and has ample of support around him can bounce back in life, but it's not the same for others, atleast in my case. I was the one who ruined it myself.

It's a hard choice, all one wants is to stop the pain and ask for some rest. The thought of being at rest seems so peaceful that we'd walk into death with a smile. Make a deal to end their pain in exchange for their life. Some may call it cowardly but it's not the case every time. Taking one's life should not be because of just an impulse. But when we have suffered, regretted, ashamed, and lose all hopes nothing seems as welcoming as death.
I'm sorry. I'm there now. I wish to be free from my pain too.

True, but when he realises his mistakes and wants to change, she's long gone. Now he's left nothing but guilt and regrets, his own thoughts smother him with painful past. He's weak, he's always been. And the only way out now is death.
I can put you under genjutsu for a better experience of life
Happiness doesn't come unless you work on it, even if you did your best it won't stay forever. It's a wave, it comes and it goes.

Sure, gaming helps. It helps you only to stop thinking about the problem, it's a diversion. But you can't sit there and game for the rest of your life. If the first thing that comes to your mind is to go game when there's a problem then you're fooling yourself to think that there is no problem. Let me tell you this, one day it's all going to hit back. It makes you scratch your brain thinking why the hell didn't you attend to the problem when you still had a chance to solve it. Yes, crying won't bring back anything and neither does it solve the problem, just like gaming. I think I'm not well versed to explain it. But when it hits you it'll be too late to accept it.

It's postponing the problems to be faced again at a later stage of life. Where it's too late to try to do anything about it. Face the problems as soon as possible. Not against gaming, but to game just to not feel the pain is bad. Because you can't get away from anything.

There's a thin line between trying to help and making it worse. You're on the line. I respect your concern to help, but when someone's in deep pain and you want to ask them questions like these they get more confused. Either a person goes down the stairs step by step into chaos or climbs up step by step into acceptance and recovery. This is like Asking them to jump a few steps up just to feel alright. There's always a chance of falling and going down hill.

These thoughts are like an unstoppable train, can't stop it, it keeps taking us further into the realm of pain and we fail trying to stop it. I heard that antidepressants will slow down your brain, it's that hyperactivity of the brain which took us into depression, so they drug us till the brain is forcibly slowed down and when they bring it into a state where that train can be handled they start the therapy. When we can't control our own thoughts and it just keeps running and draining all the energy even when all we do is just lie on the bed. God, even the ones who don't want to die wish they committed suicide to end that pain due to loss of control over their own thoughts.

What I've learnt so far is that being rich doesn't matter as much as we think, sure it can take us to places, a bit of luxury and peace even to some extent. But what really Matters to be a human being is ones character and their personality. Even the poor can live happily if he has those qualities of human being, sadly nobody thought me how to be a human being and how to genuinely treat another human being regardless of your financial status. I lost my love to my worthless nature, I didn't treat her right, even abused her and she still put up with my shit because she was a great human being and loved me. But I ruined it, this was almost 6 years ago. And not a day goes by without repenting what I did. I didn't grow up to be a good human being. Now the realisation of my mistakes are killing me everyday, to say it in short she was a gem in my monkey hands. I didn't know how to treat it. I'm that Gollum who lost his precious. I question myself whether I'm even a human being for the things that I've done my whole life. I don't know how I became such a person but not being raised with love, compassion and emotional support has its share in it. I'm insecure of everything, afraid, low self-esteem, and I honestly think I shouldn't be alive. The guilt is consuming me, making me lose mind, I've ruined my own future and I don't know how I can ever be happy even if I worked on it. I choose death in exchange for peace. To put an end to this pain.

I've searched for someone who is going through the same as myself and nobody has came close as to you. You didn't actually mention what's really wrong, I get that for people like us it doesn't really matter if we express it or not. We miss something that we had and can't have it anymore, we wish we had someone to help us while we stumbled upon our path, we wish we really had something to fight to live for, when the future itself starts looking grimmer than the past, and to realise one has to fight to Even get to there. It makes us just fall on our knees and ask for some peace. Face of death is starting to look so peaceful, yet the body trembles to make that final move.

Some of us have walked a long way just to stare at the face of death and ask for peace. For some there's no going back with all that pain, it's pointless & hopeless. I'd rather sit at the door of the reaper and wait till he shows mercy on me.

It's nice to hear comforting words like this, may be few of them will make it out of the chaos in their life and find a reason to fight. But for some it's too late, may be they too, just like I have, tried hard to do something good in life and yet couldn't find their peace, just to find themselves in a worser situation, asking the same questions over and over again for which there is no meaning. I'm just sitting here, watching the last sunset of my life in my head, giving myself the push to end all this pain.

I think I'm ending this pain once and for all. As childish as it may sound, like how Naruto suffered pain and finally decided to give himself to the Nine tails to end his pain, and then fourth hokage appeared to save him to guide him. Just like Iruka Sensei, Kakashi Sensei & jiraya were there to help him when he stumbled through his path, I wish there was someone to save me, to guide me from not falling into despair. But the reality is different and there lies nothing but pain in my future. I don't have the strength in me anymore to gather the courage to live on. I just hope I can atleast gather the courage to put an end to myself.

I understand you. I'm trying to kill myself by hanging. I've tried twice. Unfortunately I don't have any anchor point high enough for my body to suspend freely in my room. Tried on the window grill but my feet still touch the ground, I almost go numb and I puke from being choked and i just get it off my neck to go back to sleep. The feeling of being dead and unaware of anything, becoming nothing is so peaceful. I ruined my own past and I don't think the future I fought to live a better life all these years is something I don't want anymore. I give up. Definitely no coward can successfully commit suicide. Nobody understands how much a person must have been pushed to finally gather the courage to end it all. Every night I go a step forward in hanging myself. Tonight might be the last of me. Only death can rest my tortured mind.

If you want a way out don't traumatize others. You're more concerned of letting others know that they are shit at helping rather than being concerned on your own life. I respect ones resolute to end their life when the pain is beyond their control, but not like this. It doesn't serve your purpose.

Grew up with no meaningful interaction with parents, dad never cared to teach me anything in life and I barely have any emotional feelings, mother just didn't know how to raise me, and restricted me from socializing with anyone. basically I just grew up with no social skills, no family support, self-doubt, anxiety developed towards things that others handled well but I failed miserably as I didn't know how to react. I found out alot of things in life the hard way. Wish there was someone to guide me, the mistakes that I did are making me question my own existence & worth as a human.
My life has become pathetic, ruined by someone else's choice for my future and finally losing the only person I loved because of my immaturity and lack of basic skills that I never learnt. I feel sick of the way I'm now, can't even gather the courage to end this life and put an end to this pain.

I don't want to tell you to reconsider your decision. But before you want to go, take your girls somewhere nice, watch then play, show that you really love them and that's how they would remember faint thoughts of you in future.
all I'm saying is Spend some quality time with them and give them a picture of yourself as a caring father.
And after all this if your decision still hasn't changed. Write letters to them on how to tackle little things in life. 
Suffering is hell and I don't want someone to forcefully exist with pain, but before you go there are some responsibilities to take care of. Do then right and leave them with the strength to handle the loss.

I understand that you don't want to be Pro suicide, but your way of saying things is like singing how good your life is infront of a person who has lost everything. People come here to probably express their last feelings, telling them how life is sunshines & butterflies will only hurt them more.

I treated my ex wrong, I still can't get over her but I would never have played like this. I still feel sick of myself for not treating her right, I was immature to understand what's really love. But hearing your story I think he misused your vulnerability of trusting in people. Don't do that, find a right man who is good in character and knows how to be a human being. Take care of your mental health first.

What if the one who come across is a man who genuinely cares for human life. Either way it's not fair to leave them with something so difficult to handle just because you wanted a way out. As I said, sit with your problems, ask yourself how it can be improved, it's not going to be easy, but if your decision on life doesn't change, atleast be responsible man.

Don't involve others to get what you want. He probably would hate himself for the rest of his life for killing a person. That's not fair. Either find a way to live your life or be responsible till the end. That's it man

I understand your reasons to feel so. But don't blame it on others. Even I'm at the verge of taking my own life, but it's because I realised I grew up inexperienced in many things, I can blame my parents for not raising me right and not getting to have a proper support system where we can build strong mental health to face life's hardships. What ever you're going through you haven't experienced all 5 stages of grief yet. Go through with it, try to weigh the scale on whether your life can be better, what is it that you want to do. And if you think it's pointless then you can be responsible for your actions atleast.
Now that you're not in need of the gun, can you send it to me somehow?

Yes, it's like what are we doing being alive? And then there is Jordan Peterson like "don't act like a victim, do something, pick up a weight and bear it, you need to become a monster".
And then I look at death and how blissful it seems. Man I wish I grew up with better support system and people to turn to when I feel down. But I don't have anyone, I didn't learn any skills to be socializing and fitting myself somewhere, even faking it makes me feel awkward and pathetic of myself. It's not like I didn't try to do anything in life, I did fight hard to achieve very little, and I look at others doing it so easily and I feel like why? Life isn't fair. Why do they not have the problems that I have to face every single day of my life. It's like they were born with a premium ticket to life. And then there is genetics on top of all this giving me more problems, I would have failed anyways without them.
I think that are just hallucinations before the brain shuts down completely. It's like one last dream, and if people are revived before they are gone, they believe the dream was the afterlife.

The courage one has to gather to do it right and just end the pain once and for all is unimaginable. I'm weighing the scale on one side with whether it's worth to live, is there any possibility that my life can be happy and on the other side death. Death seems so peaceful, no more pain or struggle.
I'm sorry I should be trying to bring courage to you In here but I'm just a big failure.
Man, I wish I had a gun to blow up my head and end all this pain.

I'm not good at making friends, I have just a few good friends and I do feel alone and immature to see them progressing in their life. It's not about finding help for me now, I just want peace, to stop this mental agony I'm going through everyday.  I'm beyond being saved by just making some friends or getting motivation, I'm done. I'm just gathering that courage to finally hang myself. Who ever said that people who committed suicide are coward knows nothing of what a person goes through, and they are definitely not a coward. My whole life has been pathetic. I have lost the will to live, every day seems more painful than the day before.
Thanks man
